data.summary:
Results-driven Product Owner and Business Analysis leader with 14+ years of experience delivering large-scale digital transformation, platform modernization, and operational optimization initiatives within investment banking and financial services.
Proven expertise in:
• • • • •
Product Ownership and Agile delivery Legacy modernization and mainframe decommissioning Trade lifecycle and post-trade operations BPMN process modeling and workflow transformation AI-driven automation and operational efficiency initiatives Stakeholder management across global cross-functional teams
Demonstrated success in driving modernization programs, reducing manual effort, improving operational efficiency, and delivering scalable enterprise platforms aligned with business and regulatory objectives.
NOTABLE ACCOMPLISHMENTS
Reduced manual reporting dependency by 40% through reporting platform modernization.
Eliminated 7 FTEs worth of manual effort through workflow automation initiatives.
Improved operational efficiency by 20–30% across multiple transformation programs.
Led enterprise modernization initiatives involving microservices migration and cloud-ready infrastructure adoption.
Delivered Agile product releases across complex global banking environments.

raw_sections.experience:
Associate Vice President – Product Owner PSPO-A, CSM
WORK EXPERIENCE
Apr 2024 – May 2026| Associate Vice President – Product Owner | Wells Fargo India
Legacy Modernization:

Led Product Ownership for enterprise banking applications, defining product vision, roadmap, and feature prioritization aligned with strategic modernization objectives.

Conducted current-state and future-state process analysis using Microsoft Visio and BPMN 2.0 standards to identify process gaps and optimize operational workflows.

Drove migration of enterprise applications from monolithic legacy architecture to modular Java-based platforms, improving scalability and maintainability.

Led Product Ownership activities for migration to the Red Hat OpenShift platform, enabling transition to next-generation cloud-ready infrastructure.

Directed SIT and UAT execution, ensuring high-quality releases and alignment with business and technical requirements.
Revenue Cycle Transformation:

Directed strategic migration from legacy MS Access workflows to scalable microservices- based platforms supporting billing and reconciliation operations.

Improved system reliability by 20% through modernization and workflow optimization initiatives.

Facilitated stakeholder workshops across operations, accounting, finance, and WIM teams to gather and prioritize business requirements.

Led data migration strategy and execution, ensuring seamless transition and data integrity across multiple legacy databases.
Dec 2021 – Apr 2024 | Senior Consultant – Business Analysis & Product Owner (Trade life cycle) | Capco Technologies- Morgan Stanley
Mainframe Decommission:

Led strategic decommissioning initiatives for legacy mainframe platforms, identifying modernization opportunities and defining transformation roadmaps.
Managed Agile product backlog, sprint execution, and release governance across global delivery teams.

Translated complex business requirements into actionable user stories and functional specifications, ensuring alignment between operations and technology teams.

Designed and launched a UI-based reporting platform that reduced manual dependency on static reports by 40%, improving operational efficiency across global teams.

Facilitated stakeholder engagement sessions to identify workflow bottlenecks and drive future-state process improvements.
Jul 2021 – Dec 2021 | Senior Consultant | Xoriant Solutions- Finastra

Translated business objectives into conceptual application designs to improve usability and operational efficiency.
Managed end-to-end testing lifecycle including test planning, test execution, defect management, and UAT coordination.

Collaborated with production support teams to implement enhancements and resolve critical system issues.
Oct 2013 – Jul 2021 | Senior Business Analyst & Product Owner | BNP Paribas India solutions
Global Hiport (Post trade books and records platform):

Conducted data-driven analysis to identify product enhancement opportunities, improving user satisfaction by 15%.

Collaborated with business users, product owners, and development teams to ensure seamless product delivery.
Managed testing governance and defect resolution processes, achieving 100% defect
resolution before production deployment.

Streamlined testing workflows and approval processes, improving delivery timelines and stakeholder alignment.
Project CIBOT:

Led automation eliminating 7 FTEs worth of manual effort.
initiative for subscription and redemption transaction processing,

Designed centralized workflow solution enabling direct transaction processing and exception management.

Spearheaded stakeholder workshops and future-state process definition activities.

Partnered with technical teams to support architecture and integration design.
Apr2012 – Oct 2013 | Associate | TCS e-Serve
Project Rainbow:

Supported enterprise transformation initiatives focused on optimizing prime brokerage trading workflows.

Automated trade order processing through Straight-Through Processing (STP), reducing operational errors and improving transaction turnaround times.

Streamlined post-trade support and asset setup processes through UI modernization initiatives, improving operational efficiency by 30%.

Supported testing and implementation activities for enterprise workflow transformation
